From what was once a sonic unknown, P-pop has flourished into a full-fledged movement. Over the past year, the genre has dominated the Billboard Philippines charts, sold out arenas, and shown the world what Filipino music has in store. But this evolution — from cult curiosity to cultural force — was only made possible through pure grit and an unwillingness to back down. It was a triumph earned, not handed.

For #G22 (@G22Official), the spirit of resilience is the name of the game: never backing down from a challenge, no matter how uncertain the road ahead, and always staying true to their ‘palaban’ spirit. Fearlessly pushing the genre forward, the trio proves that the future of Filipino pop is in capable hands. Now, at the forefront of a new wave of artists reshaping the sound of OPM, it’s only fitting that the Female Alphas of P-pop grace one of our June 2025 covers — proudly carrying the same fire and determination that took them to the top.

Print copies are available at https://t.co/DS8tmTDn7y and the Sari Sari Kiosks in Estancia Mall, Eastwood Mall, and Festival Mall.

Get your physical copy now: https://t.co/GhtonsQtLZ

Photographed by Alexis Dave Co. Creative & Fashion Direction by Daryl Chang. Art Direction by Nicole Almero.

Styling by Eldzs Mejia, assisted by Carl Alberto & Miggs Leguera. Makeup by Jay Salcedo (Alfea & AJ). Makeup by Marben Talanay (Jaz). Hair by Jay Wee (Alfea, AJ, & Jaz). Production Design by Arj Madz. Photography assisted by Cedie Barrameda & Joey Haber. Produced by Mika Cruz.

Written by Gab Saulog. Billboard Philippines, June 2025.

On G22: AJ JAVIER Suit jacket and suit dresses.

#BillboardPhilippines
#BillboardPH
#G22forBillboardPH
